Layers

    Opening the diagram…

    Properties

    Keys and gestures

    Clickselect what moves as a whole; again, one level in
    Shift+clickadd to the selection, or take away; then Delete or Ctrl+G
    Dragmove it within its layout: another cell, place or group
    Ctrl-draginto any container under the pointer
    Alt-dragnudge it
    Corner dotdrag it to another box to draw a line
    Edge squaresdrag them to change a grid span
    Double-clickedit the text, or a line's label
    ↑ ↓ ← →sibling before, after; parent; first child
    Alt + arrowsmove before, after; out of the parent, into the sibling before
    Enter, Deleteedit the text; delete (a box with its lines)
    Ctrl+D, Ctrl+Gduplicate; group (Ctrl+Shift+G ungroups)
    Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Yundo, redo
    Ctrl+= / −, Shift+1 / 0zoom in, out; fit, 100% (Ctrl+wheel zooms too)
    Escselect the parent, or stop connecting
